core_meaning.primary_meaning: Murtazi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who is content, satisfied”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Murtazi corresponds to the Arabic form مُرْتَضِي (Arabic root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w); مُرْتَضِي (Murtadī)). Its core sense is murtazi; one who is content, satisfied. Murtazi is Arabic مُرْتَضِي (Murtadī) 'one who is content, satisfied', from the root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w). The source gloss 'One who strives, struggles' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

faq.a: Documented usage records Murtazi as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
